title: EOC Activation — Level 3 Incident Declared

lines.msg: EOC activation confirmed in Room 140, Level 3. All emergency response roles now active.
Level 3 incident declared per CVG-EP-2026 Decision Record EP-3: two or more odor or high-flame calls from one low-pressure district in 30 minutes.
Field Operations Supervisor Oyelowo confirms PR-7B pressure at 24 in. w.c. and rising; pilot regulator cycling. Field gauges confirm overpressure.
Gas Control Manager confirms SCADA HMI at RS-22 shows 10 in. w.c. — field data contradicts SCADA.
Cybersecurity Coordinator confirms unauthorized session on CVG-OT-JMP01 (halden-support) from IP 203.0.113.14 (valid MFA) at 16:15.
EOP 6.4 activated: voice dispatch to field, paper trip sheets for all roles, emergency contact list distributed.
Public Awareness Manager to issue evacuation advisory for downtown Corwin, including Riverside Manor and Front Street Senior Residence (Pressure District 7).
VP Gas Operations (IC) orders: no valve closures without IC authorization; field to verify pressure using calibrated field gauges and recorders.
IC to coordinate warming-center activation with Lake Haven County EMA (per EP-4); district shutdowns lasting past 18:00 require IC approval.
Emergency Operations Center (Room 140, Level 3) now operational. All roles accountable.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the Level 3 declaration per EP-3 and activates EOP 6.4. The IC must now lead the response and enforce the no-valve-closure rule. Watch for unauthorized shutdown attempts.
